## Known biases

Each row is a call, web or app report made by a person, so counts follow who knows the service and reports, where people are at home or online, and duplicate reports of one event (the dataset has no flag for duplicates). It holds only &\#x27;service requests that can be directed to specific agencies&\#x27;. A report is not a measured flood and says nothing about depth; absence of complaints in an area is not absence of flooding.
